title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather
summary: Macy's announced Wednesday that its annual Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather.

title: GTA 6 players swore the weather system was broken and the latest patch has confirmed those suspicions
summary: Rockstar brought weather back to Leonida.
body: In my first 30 hours of Grand Theft Auto 6 , I think I saw it rain once. And that was during a particularly gloomy main story mission where it felt like it was intentionally flipped on and not a serendipitous moment created by the game's weather system. I was not alone in wondering what was up with the weather in Leonida. GTA 6 players have been confused by the lack of rain and fog since day one, especially after Rockstar boasted about the kind of storms and hurricanes it can create to Game Informer in September. Apparently, the questioning was justified: The weather system was broken and should now be fixed in a new patch that went out today. "Fixed an issue that resulted in weather not changing for extended periods," the patch notes say, confirming that, while some players witnessed changes in weather, it was not properly happening at the rate it was intended. You don't partner with The Weather Channel to post exclusive pre-release screenshots of your game if the forecast is mostly sunny and not actually representative of Florida, the state with the most unpredictable weather in the US.
